title: Investigating the Impact of Advertising on Smoking Cessation: The Role of Direct-to-Consumer Prescription Drug Advertising
eligible_reason: Effect of DTC advertising for smoking-cessation drugs: prescription and retail demand regressed on continuous log ad stock (GRP goodwill) with MSA-by-year, month and week FE, plus a DMA-border design and Poisson variants. Continuous treatment, no binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: marketscan_fit_reduced_demand_model.R builds form <- target ~ ad-stock terms | MSA^year + year_month + year_week_index (+ border FE); rms_fit_reduced_demand_model.R analogous at store level.
data_files_note: README: the shipped dataset is synthetic and unrelated to the real data; Nielsen AdIntel, RMS and Merative MarketScan must be licensed.
software_notes: R (fixest) for estimation; Python for cleaning and tables.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
